usageNotes: Use this to update an existing notification matcher's targeting rules, severity filters, calendar windows, or assigned targets. Requires Mapping.Modify on /mapping/notifications. Supply the digest from the GET response to guard against concurrent edits overwriting each other. To clear an optional field (e.g. remove match-calendar entries), pass the field name(s) in the delete array rather than setting them empty.

examples.summary: Update matcher to route critical and error backup notifications to a Gotify target, effective only on weekdays

params.comment: Weekday backup failure alerts to ops Gotify channel

tips: The delete param accepts an array of param names (e.g. ["match-calendar"]) to unset fields — you cannot clear them by omitting them or passing empty arrays.
mode: 'all' requires every specified match-* condition to be true simultaneously; mode: 'any' fires on the first match — pick carefully when combining severity and field filters.
invert-match negates the entire combined result, useful for 'notify on anything except' patterns.
match-field values must be prefixed with 'exact:' or 'regex:' followed by field=value; omitting the prefix causes a validation error.
Returns null on success — check for HTTP 200 to confirm the update was applied.
